name: dayze
description: Life context for ChatGPT and Codex — private get_context_pack plus public notable-people packs. Sign in with Dayze. No API key in the plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Life context MCP for ChatGPT and Codex
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to Dayze over Streamable HTTP MCP. After OAuth, call get_context_pack for the signed-in user's life graph. Public notable_* tools work without login (x402 after the anonymous free tier). Writes (log_food, log_event, and similar) require scope context.
defaultPrompt: Use Dayze to pull my context pack for this week.
Search Dayze notables for Albert Einstein and fetch the pack.
Log that I had laksa for lunch in Tiong Bahru.
